items.question: How is Meet.AI different from a note-taker?
items.answer: The AI doesn't just record: it joins by voice, answers when called by name, and you can ask it about the meeting later with timestamped answers.

items.question: Does it support Vietnamese?
items.answer: Yes. The interface, the AI voice and the notes all support Vietnamese. Vietnamese transcripts are generated from the recording after the meeting for accurate diacritics.

items.question: Do participants need an account?
items.answer: No. Guests open the invite link and type their name; the host can admit each person.

items.question: What does the free plan include?
items.answer: 5 meetings and 10 AI voice minutes a month, 1 AI assistant and up to 3 people per room. Notes, transcripts and Ask AI are included.

items.question: How are AI minutes counted?
items.answer: Only the time the AI speaks counts. Notes, transcripts and text Ask AI don't use AI minutes. In “Silent” mode the AI never speaks, so it uses none.

items.question: Where is meeting data stored?
items.answer: On the cloud providers listed in our Privacy Policy. You can download or delete your data at any time.

items.question: Does it work on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. Meet.AI runs in mobile browsers, no app install needed.

items.question: Can I cancel any time?
items.answer: Yes. Manage or cancel your plan in the billing portal; it stays active until the end of the paid period.

security.metaDescription: How Meet.AI protects meetings, recordings and personal data: access control, short-lived signed links, recording consent, data deletion.
security.title: Security at Meet.AI
security.subtitle: Meetings hold sensitive information. Here is how we protect it.

sections.title: Access control
items: Only the organizer and invited people can join a meeting.
Guests go through a waiting room and the host admits each one.
Video call tokens only work for that meeting and expire within hours.

sections.title: Recordings and notes
items: Recordings open only through short-lived signed links after an access check.
Shared notes links are read-only and can be revoked at any time.
You can delete a meeting or your whole account in Settings.

sections.title: Consent and transparency
items: Everyone sees a recording and AI notice before joining.
The list of data processors is published in the Privacy Policy.
Analytics cookies are only enabled with your consent.

sections.title: Infrastructure
items: All connections use HTTPS with HSTS and security headers.
Rate limits on sign-in, meeting creation and costly APIs.

security.report: If you find a security issue, please send it through the Contact page. We respond within 72 hours.

about.metaDescription: Meet.AI is an AI meeting assistant built Vietnamese-first: it listens, speaks and remembers.
about.title: About Meet.AI
about.lead: We believe meetings are for deciding, not for taking notes.
body: Most note-taking tools are built for English. In Vietnamese, transcripts lose their diacritics, names come out wrong and notes miss the point. Meet.AI started from that problem.

Meet.AI invites an AI assistant into the meeting like a teammate: it listens, answers when called by name, writes notes the way Vietnamese teams write them, and remembers every decision so you can ask later.
Beyond team meetings, Meet.AI is an interview practice partner, an IELTS Speaking examiner and a sales coach, available 24/7.
